name: burrow-agent
description: The agent panel: a right-hand conversation wired to your local Claude Code CLI (your account, no API key). See docs/plans/03-agent-panel.md.

scripts.test: node test/transport.test.js && node test/sessions.test.js && node test/model.test.js

burrow.agent.cliPath.markdownDescription: The Claude Code CLI to spawn. Empty = look for `claude` on PATH, then `~/.local/bin/claude`. Your Claude Code **account** is the only credential — `ANTHROPIC_*` variables are stripped from the child environment, and no API key is stored, requested, or supported.

burrow.agent.model.markdownDescription: Model alias passed to the CLI (`opus`, `sonnet`, …). Empty = whatever your CLI defaults to.

burrow.agent.contextBudgetTokens.markdownDescription: How much context to send with a question, in rough tokens. Layers are added cheapest-first (workspace, open pages, page bundle, live surface, selection, debug, data, memory) and the ones that do not fit are named in the panel rather than dropped silently.

burrow.agent.memory.enabled.markdownDescription: Read the repo's own `.claude/memory/*.yaml` rows into the context envelope when they apply to the file you have open. Deterministic — no model call decides what to load.

burrow.agent.insights.enabled.markdownDescription:
Produce an automatic three-bullet card about the file you open.

**Off by default, deliberately:** every card is a real turn against your Claude Code account, and on a large repo a turn can cost around $0.30 — a background feature should not spend that until you ask it to. Cards are cached per file+content, so re-opening something you have already looked at is free.

burrow.agent.insights.languages.markdownDescription: Languages that get insight cards. Everything else is left alone.

burrow.agent.insights.maxPerHour.markdownDescription: Ceiling on insight cards per rolling hour. When it is reached the panel says so and pauses rather than failing quietly.

burrow.agent.denyGlobs.markdownDescription: Extra paths the agent may never read, send, or patch, on top of the built-in list (`**/.env*`, `**/infra/secrets/**`, `**/*.pem`, `**/*.key`, `**/secret*`, `**/.claude/settings.local.json`, `**/node_modules/**`, `**/.git/**`). The built-ins always apply — this list can only add to them.
